routing: 'that car at the park, what color was it again': expected recall, got chat
learn from natural wording: 'leo is my brother' -> 'who is leo': [I'm not sure] I don't know that. It isn't in my drawers.
'btw my birthday is march 3rd' -> 'when is my birthday': [I'm not sure] I don't know that. It isn't in drawer 1, and I don't guess about your personal life.
'maya is my sister' -> 'who is maya': [I'm not sure] I don't know that. It isn't in my drawers.
'i drive a red truck' -> 'what do i drive': [I'm not sure] I don't know that. It isn't in drawer 1, and I don't guess about your personal life.
recall with time phrases: 'what did we watch three days ago': [I remember] Watched the robotics club demo. (School, watching, Mon 5:00 PM)
forgetting on request: "my brother's name is leo" / "forget that my brother's name is leo" -> "what's my brother's name": [I know] Your brother's name is leo.
"my dog's name is biscuit" / "forget about my dog's name" -> "what is my dog's name": [I know] Your dog's name is biscuit.
